project_type: Mastra (TypeScript, ES2022/NodeNext) news-to-Instagram pipeline + a Python CDP browser-automation scraper (tweetytweets). RSS ingest -> rank -> select -> fact pack -> image -> RAS payload -> DRY_RUN handoff. X posts are a signal source.
build_system: npm; tsx for crons/demos; mastra CLI for dev/build. ES modules ("type":"module"). Zod 4. libSQL via a generic createLibSqlRepository<T>. No new npm or Python deps. Windows + PowerShell: chain commands with ';' NEVER '&&'. Scraper shells to plain 'python' (pythoncore-3.14-64; 'websockets' installed).
test_framework: node:test + node:assert/strict, run via tsx --test over an EXPLICIT file list in package.json's 'test' script (new test files MUST be added to that list or they will not run).
verification_instructions: In PowerShell (';' separator): run `npm run typecheck`; then `npm run test`; then `$env:X_DISCOVERY_ENABLED="false"; npm run auto:dry` (feed-only); then the mock-X auto:dry path; then `npm run x:discover:demo` (offline). Grep is NOT verification. AGENTS.md requires loading the `mastra` skill before any Mastra work and verifying Mastra APIs against node_modules/@mastra/*/dist/docs or source; use the dev/build npm scripts, never `mastra dev`/`mastra build` directly; register agents/tools/workflows/scorers in src/mastra/index.ts.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No codegen/snapshot step. Tests are hand-written.
environment_constraints: HARD CONSTRAINTS (never violate): post NOTHING; keep INSTAGRAM_DRY_RUN and REQUIRE_APPROVAL defaulting true; NO git commit/push/config changes; the RSS pipeline MUST keep working if X is unavailable; NEVER bypass/solve a captcha or login wall; every tunable number in config with conservative defaults; FAIL SOFT everywhere X touches the main pipeline (never throw into the news run); LLM judges MEANING only and code decides every number that affects ranking, promotion, budgets, selection, pacing; the LLM never emits a handle or a final score. Do NOT restart any long-running cron. Windows PowerShell env var set is `$env:NAME="value"`.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: load the `mastra` skill FIRST; verify Mastra APIs against installed packages not memory; register all agents/tools/workflows/scorers in src/mastra/index.ts; use npm `dev`/`build` scripts. Each FEAT commits locally on the branch and NEVER pushes.
key_patterns: Gateways are an interface + a libSQL impl (via createLibSqlRepository<T>("table")) + an in-memory stub factory, mirroring RankStorageGateway/createStubGateway in src/mastra/lib/ranking/storage.ts. Config files expose envNum/envFlag helpers and a getXxxConfig() returning a merged object with conservative defaults (see src/mastra/config/xAccounts.ts and ranking.config.ts). Crons mirror src/mastra/cron/runAutoNewsRadar.ts (daemon + --once + --demo, in-process overlap guard, loadEnvFile). LLM stages ask for plain JSON and parse with extractJson + Zod safeParse + retry-once + fail-soft (see src/mastra/lib/ranking/llmScore.ts); the final number is computed in code (score.ts). normalizeUrl in src/mastra/lib/normalize.ts strips tracking/hash/AMP/trailing-slash but does NOT lowercase the host. canonicalKey (lib/safety/ledger-key.ts) is per-item (normalizeUrl + content hash) and NEVER collides across X and RSS, so it must NOT be used for corroboration. ranking weights currently sum to exactly 10.0 (invariant: Σ wᵢ·componentᵢ ∈ [0,100]). RawContent.metadata is a free-form z.record used to carry X fields into ranking.
